Trump Pardons Alaskan Auto Workers in Emissions Case

During a rally in Alaska, former U.S. President Donald Trump issued pardons to two auto workers. The pardons were related to a Biden-era emissions case concerning the removal of environmental components from vehicle engines. The pardoned individuals operated vehicle repair shops in Alaska.
